description.zh:
共享型云电脑ID。

- 如果传入了`DesktopId`，则忽略该`DesktopGroupId`。
- 如果`DesktopId`为空，则会根据`DesktopGroupId`去获取该共享型云电脑内所有云电脑的`DesktopId`。
description.en:
The ID of the shared cloud desktop.

- If you specify `DesktopId`, the system ignores `DesktopGroupId`.

- If `DesktopId` is empty, the system uses `DesktopGroupId` to retrieve the `DesktopId` of all cloud desktops in the shared cloud desktop group.

description.zh: 共享型云电脑 ID 列表。
description.en: A list of shared cloud desktop group IDs.

description.zh: 云电脑 ID 列表。可设置 1~100 个。
description.en: A list of cloud desktop IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs.

description.zh:
付费类型。
> 仅对重置共享型云电脑有效，为空则重置共享型云电脑下所有付费类型的云电脑。
description.en:
The billing method.

> This parameter applies only when resetting shared cloud desktops. If you leave it empty, the system resets all cloud desktops in the shared cloud desktop group, regardless of their billing method.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. Call [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) to list regions that support WUYING Workspace.

description.zh: 重置范围，可以通过配置参数来设置是重置镜像还是重置云电脑。
description.en: The scope of the reset operation. Set this parameter to reset either the image or the cloud desktop.

description.zh: 重置类型，决定是否重置，以及要重置的磁盘范围。
description.en: The reset type. This determines whether to reset and which disks to reset.

descriptions.zh: > 本接口仅适用于重置共享型云电脑（即共享型云电脑内的云电脑），不支持重置普通云电脑。
descriptions.en: > This operation applies only to shared cloud desktops. It does not support resetting standard cloud desktops.
